description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Collective Agreements No. 17 of 2015 entered into between Noritake Lanka Porcelain (Pvt.) Ltd. and the Inter Company Employees Union and No. 30 of 2015 entered into between People's Bank and the Ceylon Bank Employees' Union and No. 09 of 2015 entered into between Associated Battery Manufactures (Ceylon) Limited and the Commercial and Industrial Workers Union
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a private company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, salary structures, allowances, disciplinary procedures, and other labor regulations. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks governing industrial relations.
